subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-party memory-core operator facade for remember/recall/review/edit/forget, or leave this capability to external plugins/ClawHub until the canonical Memory MVP schema and write/review flows land?
rationale: The requested commands would define durable memory lifecycle semantics and plugin-slot behavior, which source inspection shows are not just missing wiring around existing commands.

options.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface design anchor and require maintainer approval after the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge.

options.title: Move To External Package First
options.body: Ask contributors to prototype this as a ClawHub skill/plugin such as the Engram Core-style approach until OpenClaw exposes any missing generic API seams.

options.title: Reject First-Party Surface
options.body: Close the Memory MVP operator facade if maintainers decide memory write/review/forget commands should not be a default OpenClaw product surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface design anchor and require maintainer approval after the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core CLI/docs and VISION ownership make this the best available routing candidate for the product-surface decision.
